## Checklist / רשימת בדיקות חובה לפני מיזוג

- [ ] **Build Verification**: `npm run build` completed cleanly with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- [ ] **Strict Zero-PII**: Verified that no personal names, personal email addresses, local absolute paths (`/Users/...`), or private API keys are present in any code, commits, or documentation.
- [ ] **Hebrew RTL Invariant**: All Hebrew user-facing text renders properly with native Right-to-Left alignment.
- [ ] **Age-Appropriate Pedagogy (Grade 5 / Ages 10–11)**: Technical concepts are explained with child-friendly analogies; avoid college-level math/jargon without clear intuition.
- [ ] **Grammatical Standard**: Instructions and copy use unambiguous plural (`לחצו`, `נסו`, `שלכם`) or neutral action nouns (`פתיחת שער`), with strictly ZERO singular masculine address (`לחץ`, `שלך`).
- [ ] **Child-Friendly Visual Affordance**: Emojis are preserved in game boards and simulations (🔑, 🏆, 🔒/🔓, ⭐) for engagement, while system UI controls use Lucide icons exclusively.
- [ ] **Changelog**: `CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.he.md` have been updated synchronously adhering to SemVer.
- [ ] **Responsive Viewports**: Verified on both desktop and mobile/tablet viewport sizes without horizontal scrolling or clipped text.
